title: New York
short description: New York has a land area of 47,123.4 square miles and a water area of 7,435.1 square miles. It is the 30th largest state by area.
description: New York has a land area of 47,123.4 square miles and a water area of 7,435.1 square miles. It is the 30th largest state by area. New York is bordered by New Jersey, Massachusetts, Vermont, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, and Rhode Island.
